description:
It’s a strider, It’s a pedal bike. The Minnē Monē is a really good bike, for kids.

This thing is out of control…the finest cromoly steel frame with tiny little tubes. The cutest lightest version of the bi-plane fork ever produced. stable geo with a super low saddle height for stridablitly while retaining the classic double diamond shape. Slacker seat angle increases top tube length as the seat goes up. So much thoughtful design in these lil steel framesets.

The Strider! kick bike. scoot bike. LaufRad. Balance bike. A lovely take on the no-pedal bike.

12” lightweight wheels low spoke coubt and vans tires w/ sealant in the tubes

Custom Monē tiny (tinē?) 19mm sweptback brazed stem/bar w/ sdg lockon grips

Monë aluminum footrest for max coasting and bb-cover, ano’d black

full brass bit kit…seat clamp, cnc spacer, top cap with dice on the valve caps.

The Pedal Bike! Kid bike. Small bicycle. A really nice single speed, for children. Avaiable in coaster or disc brake versions.

handbuilt wheels w/ our brass nipples. These are super cool and a super big pain to build. (shimano cb-e110 and funky front hub for coaster wheels and custom 100/110mm disc/freehweel for handbrake version) Tubes w/ sealant

Minturized cro-moly brazed oddmonē bars

2 piece, direct mount, sealed outboard bearing bb, 89mm cranks (really nice kiddy daddy spec cranks)

Tektro mechanical disc brakes and tiny reach levers for the lil’ hands. Adorable 140mm rotors

matching tan vans tires and grips…Mommy like.

We have a few, built up in stock..after that, they’ll be built to order 3-6 week lead time

a friendly reminder to watch those finigies in the chain.

all brames handbrazed by the crew in Taichung, Taiwan

27.2 seatpost, 30.0 seat clamp, 100/110 spacing (sucks in for 95/95 strider hubs), standard 1 1/8 headtube/steerer, iso disc mount

spec will be nice, but up to me. If your child desires a king headset or paul hubs…let me know
